en: A black-and-white image depicting an opulent interior room with large windows, ornate clocks, and elaborate cabinets. Mounted stag and deer antlers adorn the walls above the windows, giving the room a hunting-lodge atmosphere. There are several antique chairs and fine parquet floors. The space exudes a historic, aristocratic European feel. At the bottom of the card, some handwritten or printed text appears to read 'Wien' and 'Boden', though it is mirrored.
